notes: CRAFT1-ITEM-CONVERSIONS-V1 C3a (DUR-03 §39.3 CRAFT-1 amendment); conversion shape only (ConversionCause, one CONVERSION audit aggregate), the one-item DUR03-RL-01..08 rows are unchanged and DUR03-RL-03 and DUR03-RL-05 stay 0.
